Google just started showing Instagram Reels in search results.
Your posts don’t disappear after 48 hours anymore. They can show up on Google for years.
It’s like your WhatsApp status suddenly becoming a hoarding on the highway. What you made for one day is now up for everyone, for years.
Till now, social content had a two-day life. You post, it peaks, it’s gone. Now a Reel can come up when someone Googles a question, months later.
Three small changes:
1. Say the actual question in your reel. The words people would type.
2. Put those words in your caption too, not just hashtags.
3. Make more reels that answer questions. Answers get searched. Jokes don’t.
Your old reels were posts. Your next ones can be property.
Everyone else is still making content for two days. Start making it for two years.
Save this before your next reel.
